page_title: HOL 4-2 DOR | Holstein Kiel v Dortmund 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The end of the second half.
90+9' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

90+8' 4 - 2 Gregor Kobel tries in vain to get back after he went up for that corner with time running out, but can only watch in horror as Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) takes aim and sends the ball into the unguarded net from distance. 4:2.
90+8' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) makes a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Dortmund.
90+4' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' Yan Couto (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Timon Weiner comfortably gathers the ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' What a save from Timon Weiner! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
86' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) receives a yellow card.
86' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
85' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch because Finn Porath simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
81' The yellow card goes to Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel). Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) displayed very unsporting behaviour.
77' 3 - 2 Goal! Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
76' Marco Komenda is substituted due to injury. Marcel Rapp gives a chance to Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel).
76' Here is a change. Shuto Machino is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel).
76' Substitution. Phil Harres leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
75' Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' The attendance is 15034.
73' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

71' 3 - 1 Brilliant finish! Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Waldemar Anton, then produced a nice strike into the left side of the goal. The score is 3:1.

70' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alexander Bernhardsson will be replaced by Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel).

67' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Dortmund are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
66' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) brings his opponent down. Martin Petersen has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Dortmund are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
62' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
61' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Dortmund.
60' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) is penalised for a foul. Martin Petersen had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Dortmund.

59' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
59' Nuri Sahin has decided to substitute Julien Duranville and he is replaced by Yan Couto (Dortmund).
59' The substitution has been made. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) has replaced Marcel Sabitzer.
59' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
58' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Poor challenge! Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is penalised for tripping and Martin Petersen blows his whistle. Holstein Kiel are awarded the free kick.
49' Flag goes up against Julien Duranville (Dortmund) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' Dortmund are ruled offside.
47' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
47' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
46' The game is over for Ramy Bensebaini. Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) comes on for the second half.
46' Nuri Sahin has made a change at the break. Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) has come on in place of Julian Ryerson.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Martin Petersen blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' 3 - 0 Phil Harres produces a sweet pass and picks out Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 3:0!

45+2' A clever short pass gives Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
45+1' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
45+1' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Dortmund have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' Yellow card. Julien Duranville (Dortmund) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
41' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Gregor Kobel is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
40' Some patient build-up play from Dortmund as they look to unlock the defence.
39' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
37' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Martin Petersen stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

37' What an opportunity! Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!

35' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.

32' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Lasse Rosenboom and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Gregor Kobel was helpless.
31' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
29' The match is interrupted due to poor visibility and looking at the pitch, we have to agree.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
24' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' 17:83 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
24' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
22' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
21' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.

20' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Martin Petersen has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Holstein Kiel.
17' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Dortmund have a free kick.
15' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Julien Duranville (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Holstein Kiel earn a free kick.

12' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
11' It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
9' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

9' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Martin Petersen blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Dortmund win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
6' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
5' Holstein Kiel take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

5' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Gregor Kobel pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Holstein Kiel manage to earn a corner.
4' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
3' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
